hints.title: Target Window Dimension
hints.text: The total number of 1s in the array defines the exact length of the continuous block needed after all swaps.

hints.title: Fixed Size Slice
hints.text: Count total 1s as window size W. If W <= 1, zero swaps are required.

hints.title: Maximize 1s Inside Window
hints.text: Slide a window of length W across the array to find the maximum number of 1s inside any window. The minimum swaps needed is W minus that maximum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking all windows from scratch takes quadratic O(N * W) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding a fixed-size window of length W tracks entry and exit counts in linear time and constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should convert the grouping problem into finding the subarray of length W with maximum 1s.
complexity.notes: Every 0 within the chosen window must be swapped with a 1 from outside.
